description: Return today's ordered plan and suggestions using the user's saved timezone. This is not every task. Requires a timezone in Lemongraph Settings. Use returned IDs for actions. When the user selects a task to work on, call get_task_context with its eight-character data.key, not the card's top-level key. Each task's agent field names the application working on it, or is null.
name: get_today
title: Get today
